Checklist Item: All focusable elements have :focus or :focus-visible styles with visible outline/box-shadow/border change; no outline:none or outline:0 without replacement focus style; focus ring provides >=2px visible boundary

Form validation errors use aria-invalid='true' on invalid fields; error messages linked via aria-describedby; error summary with anchor links present for forms with >3 fields; no alert() or browser-default-only validation as sole error mechanism

Modal/dialog elements have role='dialog' or role='alertdialog' with aria-modal='true' and aria-labelledby/aria-label; keydown handler for Escape key present in source; focusable elements exist inside dialog container
<video> elements have <track kind='captions'> with valid non-empty src
<audio> elements have adjacent transcript link or aria-describedby pointing to transcript content; transcript container visible (not display:none/visibility:hidden)
No focus-trap calls outside of modal/dialog components; no keydown handlers that programmatically restrict Tab key to a subset of elements on non-modal pages
No :hover-only JS event handlers (every click/mouseenter handler has a keyboard equivalent); every CSS :hover show/hide rule has a corresponding :focus or :focus-within rule on the same selector
Total animation/transition count per page within threshold; no animations >2s duration; no infinite animations on non-loading elements
All CSS :hover rules have corresponding :focus or :focus-visible rules on the same selectors
Visually-hidden patterns (.sr-only/.visually-hidden) use approved clip/position technique; no display:none or visibility:hidden on screen-reader-targeted text
